text:
### Phase 2: Containment (15–60 Minutes)  
**Objectives:**
- Stop attack/prevent spread
- Preserve evidence
- Protect unaffected systems
- Maintain business continuity  
**Containment Actions:**  
**For Cyberattack (Malware/Ransomware):**
- Isolate affected system (disconnect from network)
- Prevent further access (reset credentials, block IP)
- Preserve logs/evidence (copy before shutdown)
- Kill processes (if possible without data loss)  
**For Data Breach:**
- Identify compromised data (scope)
- Contain access (revoke credentials)
- Monitor for misuse (credit monitoring if PII)
- Preserve evidence (logs, audit trail)  
**For System Outage:**
- Failover to backup (if available)
- Isolate failed component
- Prevent escalation
- Begin restoration  
**For Fraud:**
- Freeze compromised account
- Block fraudulent transactions
- Prevent further unauthorized access
- Collect evidence

raw_entities.name: Cyberattack
raw_entities.description: A security incident involving malware or ransomware attack on bank systems. Requires immediate isolation of affected systems, credential reset, evidence preservation, and process termination to prevent spread and maintain business continuity.
context: Prevent further access (reset credentials, block IP)

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: An incident involving unauthorized access to or compromise of customer data. Containment requires identifying the scope of compromised data, revoking credentials, monitoring for misuse, and preserving evidence including logs and audit trails.
context: Monitor for misuse (credit monitoring if PII)

raw_entities.name: System Outage
raw_entities.description: An operational incident involving system failure or unavailability. Containment actions include failover to backup systems, isolation of the failed component, prevention of escalation, and initiation of restoration procedures.

raw_entities.name: Fraud
raw_entities.description: A fraud incident involving unauthorized account access or fraudulent transactions. Containment requires freezing the compromised account, blocking fraudulent transactions, preventing further unauthorized access, and collecting evidence.

raw_entities.name: System Isolation
raw_entities.description: Immediate disconnection of affected systems from the network to prevent spread of malware, ransomware, or unauthorized access during a cyberattack incident.

raw_entities.name: Credential Reset and Access Blocking
raw_entities.description: Action to prevent further unauthorized access by resetting compromised credentials and blocking malicious IP addresses during cyberattack or data breach containment.
context: Prevent further access (reset credentials, block IP)

raw_entities.name: Evidence Preservation
raw_entities.description: Preservation of logs, audit trails, and system evidence before shutdown or system restoration to support forensic investigation and regulatory reporting.

raw_entities.name: Process Termination
raw_entities.description: Termination of malicious or compromised processes on affected systems to stop attack progression, performed with care to avoid data loss.
context: Kill processes (if possible without data loss)

raw_entities.name: Compromised Data Scope Identification
raw_entities.description: Determination of the extent and nature of data compromised during a data breach to inform containment, notification, and regulatory reporting decisions.

raw_entities.name: Misuse Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Ongoing monitoring for unauthorized use of compromised personally identifiable information, including credit monitoring services when PII is involved.
context: Monitor for misuse (credit monitoring if PII)

raw_entities.name: Failover to Backup
raw_entities.description: Activation of backup systems to restore service availability and maintain business continuity during a system outage.

raw_entities.name: Escalation Prevention
raw_entities.description: Actions taken to prevent a system outage or incident from spreading to additional systems or increasing in severity.

raw_entities.name: System Restoration
raw_entities.description: Initiation of procedures to restore failed systems to operational status following a system outage incident.

raw_entities.name: Account Freeze
raw_entities.description: Immediate suspension of account activity to prevent further unauthorized transactions during a fraud incident.

raw_entities.name: Fraudulent Transaction Blocking
raw_entities.description: Prevention of unauthorized transactions identified as fraudulent during a fraud incident containment phase.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Access Prevention
raw_entities.description: Actions to block further unauthorized account access during a fraud incident, including credential changes and session termination.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Evidence Collection
raw_entities.description: Gathering and preservation of evidence related to fraudulent activity for investigation and potential regulatory or law enforcement reporting.
